Processed file are sorted per experiment. 
Raw data files matching the processed data in the file can be found in processsed data file:

tab: 'Raw data "date"', column E:'Run ID' --> the number in that column is the name of the raw data file. 

'Combined' excel files summarizes and combines all experimental data. Data of individual experimenst are copied
into this file to get an overview which can be used for data analysis. Per data unit, it shows a date which is of when the experiment was performed. 
This matches the data and date of the processed data files. 


0-60 min are experiments linked to the thyroid hormone uptake curve over the course of 60 minutes.

EDC experiments are linked to exposing cell lines to endocrine disrupting chemicals.
